analysis_status: Post-hoc user-requested preference index; weights chosen after component results existed, not a preregistered primary endpoint
normalization: Transformer=100 reference. Text uses the ratio of geometric mean probability assigned to correct target bytes, 2**(bpb_T-bpb_M). Tasks use ratios of held-out per-byte accuracy. Ratios are geometrically averaged across paired seeds. No arbitrary min-max scaling, clipping, pseudocounts, benchmark-standard or intelligence interpretation.
formula: R=100*exp(alpha*(beta*mean_seed(mean_text[-ln(2)*(bpb_M-bpb_T)])+(1-beta)*mean_seed(mean_task[ln(acc_M/acc_T)]))+(1-alpha)*ln(median_step_ms_T/median_step_ms_M)); alpha=beta=0.5 by assistant default, not user-stated preferences.
bootstrap_scope: 5000 resamples of three paired fitted seeds and 40 paired standalone timing trials. Conditional on fixed evaluation inputs and this host/session. This does not include fresh data/domain sampling, training hyperparameter uncertainty, other hardware or many independent model fits; three seeds are weak evidence for population inference.
conditions: Quality combines the 16000-update text-only checkpoint and separate 2000-update task-adapted checkpoint for each paired seed. It is a multi-workload workflow index, not one checkpoint simultaneously evaluated on every task.

The default speed component is the standalone median whole-model training step with equal batch and shapes. It is not time to a target quality, learning efficiency, full training cost, or monetary utility.
The 900-CPU-second comparison is kept separate and contains text only. No speed multiplier is added to that already time-matched score.

Exact-sequence accuracy and task loss remain in the full report; exact match is not included again as an overlapping metric. Zero exact match on reverse/prefix-sum and shortcut-level prefix-sum byte accuracy prevent an arithmetic or intelligence claim.
A large throughput ratio can dominate modest predictive-probability ratios. Equal weights on log ratios encode that preference; other transformations and task choices are also judgments.
No universal overall winner follows. Score differences are not percentages of intelligence, economic value, or frontier-scale benefit.
